name: JW Marriott Hotel Xi'an
positioning: Modern high-rise luxury hotel in Xi'an's CBD, with a 38th-floor lobby and panoramic city views
best_for: Travelers who want sweeping city views from a high-floor lobby and rooms
Guests who want a spa, an indoor infinity pool and a fitness center under one roof
Business and leisure travelers based in Xi'an's CBD near the subway

facts.text: The hotel is in Xi'an's CBD, in the Xi'an Economic and Technological Development Zone, next to the city's administrative center.
The hotel has direct access to the Wenjing Road subway station.
The hotel's modern design reflects Xi'an's contemporary character and the refinement of the local culture.
The hotel blends the ancient heritage of Chang'an with the style of the JW Marriott brand.
The hotel's lobby is on the 38th floor.
The hotel has an indoor heated pool, a sauna and a whirlpool.
Spa by JW is on the hotel's 24th level.
Spa treatments include Ayurvedic treatments, couples massages and facials.
Rooms are elegantly styled with the residential comforts of home.
The JW Executive Lounge is on the 36th floor, a private space for guests to relax or work.
JW Kitchen is an all-day restaurant blending local favorites with international cuisine, with à la carte dishes and an international buffet.
Jin Wei Court is a Cantonese restaurant.

highlights.text: The lobby and the guest rooms look out over panoramic views of the city.
The pool is an infinity pool.
Spa by JW is on the hotel's 24th level.
The hotel's modern design reflects Xi'an's contemporary character and the refinement of the local culture.
Room types include city-view rooms and suites, up to the Presidential Suite and Ambassador Suite.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the Xi'an Economic and Technological Development Zone, the city's CBD, next to the administrative center.
Xianyang Airport is about 27 km from the hotel.
